# Implementation

1. Confirm explicit approval of the implementation plan. Read requirements, architecture, plan, and relevant existing source/tests.
2. Implement only planned calculator behavior with the existing project conventions and dependencies. Keep changes small, readable, stateless, and within the happy-path scope; do not add a database.
3. Preserve user changes; do not overwrite unrelated work or add unapproved features or infrastructure.
4. Run focused tests/checks and, when required by the task, start the application and verify it. Report the exact commands, observed results, and any failures.
5. Summarize changed files and hand off to code review. Never claim a check ran or passed without evidence.
